scripts.test:e2e: pnpm server preview:setup && pnpm web test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:clean: pnpm server preview:setup:clean && pnpm web test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:show: pnpm server preview:setup && pnpm web test:e2e:show
scripts.test:e2e:ui: pnpm server preview:setup && pnpm web test:e2e:ui
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.convex:dev:once: pnpm server exec convex dev --once && pnpm check
scripts.convex:sync: pnpm server exec convex deploy && pnpm server exec convex codegen && pnpm check
scripts.convex:codegen: pnpm server exec convex codegen && pnpm check
scripts.prepreview: pnpm web exec playwright test e2e/auth.setup.ts --project=setup --no-deps
scripts.preview: pnpm web exec playwright open --load-storage=e2e/.auth/e2e-user.json --ignore-https-errors https://localhost:3100/dashboard --device="iPhone 17" --color-scheme=light
